note: CRIM (Puerto Rico's tax assessor) publishes the statewide Parcelario layer as crim_parcelas. Its MapServer and FeatureServer endpoints on sigejp.pr.gov and sige.pr.gov return 'Service crim/crim_parcelas/MapServer not started' (HTTP 500) on every probe and in validation; the sige.pr.gov host does not connect. The older satasgis.crimpr.net Parcelas layer, linked from the CRIM ArcGIS Online map, also does not connect. gis.pr.gov WFS (geoserver2.pr.gov pr_geodata) has no parcel layer, only index grids. Regrid and landrecords.us are commercial, not county-published services.
